questions.knowledge_point: Finding the Formula for the Sum of a Geometric Series Given the First Term and Common Ratio
questions.worked_solution:
The sum of the first $N$ terms of a geometric series can be determined by the formula

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{{a}_{1}(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r}.
$$

In this case, ${a}_{1}=15$ and $r=6.$ Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{N} & =\frac{15(1-{6}^{N})}{1-6} \\  & =-\frac{15}{5}(1-{6}^{N}) \\  & =3({6}^{N}-1).\end{aligned}
$$
